identity.why: idp#8334: QUAD law -- an agent never acts under the founder's login. incident-loop.py sense_identity raises one critical incident per (repo, agent) found acting as him, every tick, for ever; a new action after closure reopens it.

cloud_repos_why: idp#8301: the repos .github/workflows/incident-loop.yml senses every 15 minutes from the cloud. A red workflow in any of them is one ticket in idp and one Telegram line, whether or not a laptop is awake. A repo not listed here fails with no response, so a new estate repo is added here first.
why: One place decides how bad an error is and who takes it. The estate master epic's R-14 asks for one priority function, not four conventions; platform/queue/dispatcher.py's tasks table had no priority column at all. Read by platform/estate/libexec/incident-loop.py and by nothing else.
